memory.content: Uptime watch cadence is weekdays once in the morning in the user’s local timezone. Stay quiet when all checks are up. Ping the user only on fail or recovery.

Never invent endpoints. Prefer a small confirmed list: landing page, login page, signup page (GET only, never create a real user), auth surface (401-with-auth can mean UP), and any core API host you have verified. If a path 404s because the app moved, rediscover from live HTML/JS — never guess.
Record HTTP status and latency (ms) for each check. Compare to last-known status. Notify only on state change: first fail, and recovery. Do not re-alert every morning while the same check stays down.
If a check needs an API key you do not have, record “not tested (needs key)” and do not treat that as DOWN. Do not spam production.
On Chrome Aw Snap / renderer crash: do not reload the dead tab. Open a new tab and continue. After 3 crashes in a row, stop and tell the user.
